items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Richard Jones and I wrote [Canal Street Boogie]

ctx.x: Richard Jones. Richard Jones, we call him Miney Jones. He died of a heart attack, you remember? Yeah. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. and they had a bass fill. I think Lindsey was on bass and I was playing.

Yeah, I made records with him. I think you went with Sammy Stewart or something. You went away and I think that's when I recorded with him because... Yeah, I remember recording with George. Yeah. Richard Jones, we call him Miney Jones. He died of a heart attack. You remember?
